current.title: Secret CEO Ka Driver
current.logline: She thinks he's just her driver, a mere servant, to be humiliated and ordered around. But the audience knows her 'driver' is actually the billionaire CEO who secretly owns her entire family's fortune, waiting for the perfect moment to flip the script.

characters.name: Rohan Luthra
characters.role: Billionaire CEO, disguised as a driver for the Ahuja family.
characters.secret: Owner of Luthra Industries, a conglomerate that secretly controls Ahuja Industries.
characters.want: To find genuine connection, expose entitlement, and exact his revenge on those who mistreat him.

characters.name: Sanjana Ahuja
characters.secret: None, but lives in denial about her family's dwindling wealth.
characters.want: To maintain her lavish lifestyle, marry a powerful man, and assert her social dominance.

characters.name: Priya Sharma
characters.role: Ambitious Marketing Executive at Ahuja Industries.
characters.want: To prove her capabilities professionally and rise on her own merit.

arc: Part 1: Mall ke entrance par, Rohan apni purani uniform mein gaadi rokta hai. Sanjana Ahuja, poore nakhre ke saath gaadi se utarti hai, phone par kisi ko lecture dete hue. 'Tumne sunn na band kar diya hai kya, Rohan? Meri car kharab ho rahi hai! Aur yeh tumhari t-shirt? Ek driver bhi itni gandi t-shirt nahi pehenta!' Rohan bas chupchaap uski baat sunta hai, apne haath mein rakhi Ferrari ki chabi par halka sa pressure dalta hai. 'Jao, coffee leke aao. Meri meeting hai,' Sanjana ne car keys uski taraf uchhal di. Keys zameen par giri, Rohan ne jhuk kar uthai. Sanjana andar chali gayi. Rohan ne apni pocket se ek sleek, black phone nikala. 'Hello, Mr. Mehta? Aapki report aayi hai. Ahuja Industries ka valuation final ho gaya hai na?' Woh phone par baat karta hua apni gaadi ki taraf badha. Uske chehre par ek halki muskaan thi. Sanjana ka phone bajta hai. Uska bag uske haath se chhoot kar paani ke puddle mein gir gaya. 'Rohan! Rohan! Mera bag uthao!' Usne Rohan ko awaaz di. Rohan ne Sanjana ko dekha, phir neeche paani se bhare bag ko... aur ek gehri saans li.

Part 2: Rohan ne chupchaap jhuk kar Sanjana ka designer bag uthaya, uske kapde halki baarish mein bheeg chuke the. Sanjana ne bina dhanyawad bole bag chheen liya. 'Kahaan reh gaye the? Meri flight miss ho jati toh!' Rohan ne apne bheegte hue kapde dekhe, aur Sanjana ke peechhe chal diya. Office ke andar, Priya Sharma, ek nayi Marketing Executive, Sanjana ke is behaviour ko gusse se dekhti hai. 'Yeh ladki har kisi ko aise hi treat karti hai kya?' usne apne colleague se poocha. Colleague ne kandhe uchka diye. Shaam ko Sanjana ki birthday party thi. 'Rohan, jaldi se yeh drinks serve karo. Aur dhyan rakhna koi glass toote nahi,' Sanjana ne Rohan ko order diya. Rohan chupchaap trays uthata raha. Ek corner mein Sanjana ke papa, Mr. Ahuja, phone par baat kar rahe the, unki awaaz mein pareshaani thi. 'Humhe ek new investor chahiye, Jaldi! Warna company doob jayegi.' Rohan, unke paas se guzarte hue, ek pal ke liye ruka. Uske chehre par wahi halki muskaan thi. Mr. Ahuja ne apna phone band kiya. 'Kash koi miracle ho jaaye,' woh mann hi mann bole. Rohan ne unhe dekha, aur phir party ke beech se guzarte hue ek bade se glass ki taraf badha, jiske neeche ek mic laga hua tha. Rohan ne us glass mein paani dala, aur uske haath kaanp gaye. Glass uske haath se chhoot gaya, aur mic par ek zor se 'thud' ki awaaz aayi. Sabki nazrein us par thi. 'Sorry,' Rohan ne dheere se kaha. Sanjana ne gusse se uski taraf dekha. 'Tumhe ek kaam theek se nahi aata kya?!'

Part 3: Sanjana ne Rohan ko gusse se dekha. 'Nikal yahan se! Main tumhe firing letter bhejwa rahi hoon!' Rohan ne apni nazrein neeche rakhi. Mr. Ahuja ne usko rokte hue kaha, 'Sanjana! Abhi nahi!' Rohan chupchaap wahan se chala gaya. Agli subah, Rohan apne ghar mein tha, jahan woh 50th floor se sheher ko dekh raha tha. Uske haath mein tablet tha, jispar Ahuja Industries ke financial reports khule the. Woh muskuraya. 'Iss company ko doobne nahi de sakte na?' Usne phone uthaya, 'Mr. Mehta? Woh deal final ho gayi hai. Ahuja Industries ko ab 'Luthra Enterprises' acquire karegi. Bas ab us 'dummy investor' ko send kar dijiye. Aur haan, unko boliyega ki Mr. Ahuja ko time par milne aa jaaye.' Dusri taraf, Sanjana pareshaan thi. 'Papa, hum kya karenge? Woh investor toh humse mil bhi nahi raha!' Mr. Ahuja ne haath malte hue kaha, 'Pata nahi Sanjana. Lekin aaj meri ek bahot important meeting hai. Meri kismat us ek aadmi ke haath mein hai.' Rohan apni driver's uniform mein Ahuja mansion ke bahar khada tha. Mr. Ahuja car mein baithe. Rohan ne car start ki. 'Papa, yeh driver abhi bhi yahan kya kar raha hai?' Sanjana ne naak sikod kar poocha. Rohan ne peeche rearview mirror mein Sanjana ko dekha. 'Main Mr. Ahuja ko unki meeting ke liye drop karne aaya hoon, Ma'am,' Rohan ne kaha. Mr. Ahuja ne Sanjana ko chup rehne ka ishara kiya. 'Chalo, Rohan,' Mr. Ahuja ne kaha. Rohan ne gaadi aage badhai. Sanjana phone par apni friends se baat kar rahi thi. 'Agar yeh deal ho gayi na, toh main Mumbai ke sabse bade businessman se shaadi karungi!' Rohan ne uski baat suni aur ek halki muskaan uske honthon par aa gayi. Mr. Ahuja ke office ke bahar Rohan ne car roki. Mr. Ahuja utarne lage. 'All the best, Sir,' Rohan ne kaha. Mr. Ahuja muskuraye, 'Thank you, Rohan.' Rohan ne unhe dekha, aur phir apni wristwatch ki taraf. Woh jaanta tha yeh meeting kis ke saath thi.

Part 4: Ahuja Industries ke board room mein tension thi. Mr. Ahuja pareshaan the. Sanjana bhi wahan maujood thi, phone par galti se ek photo Rohan ko bhej chuki thi, jisme usne office ki secret files ki photo kheenchi thi. Rohan ke phone par notification aaya, usne muskurate hue photo dekhi. 'Yeh toh Mr. Ahuja ki strategy file hai,' woh mann hi mann bola. Board room ka darwaza khula. Ek smart, elegant aadmi andar aaya. Yeh Mr. Malhotra the, Luthra Enterprises ke 'dummy investor'. Sanjana ne khushi se unhe welcome kiya. Aur unke theek peeche, usi driver uniform mein, Rohan khada tha, Mr. Malhotra ka briefcase pakde. 'Yeh yahan kya kar raha hai?' Sanjana ne aankhen badi karte hue kaha. Mr. Malhotra ne muskurakar Rohan ko dekha. 'He's my assistant for today. Bahut capable ladka hai,' unhone kaha. Priya, jo meeting mein present thi, Rohan ko gaur se dekh rahi thi. Uski aankhon mein ek ajeeb chamak thi. Meeting shuru hui. Mr. Ahuja ne apni company ki financial report pesh ki. Mr. Malhotra ne unki baaton ko chupchaap suna. Rohan board room ke corner mein khada tha, uska chehra bilkul bhaavheen tha. 'Toh Mr. Ahuja,' Mr. Malhotra ne kaha, 'Aapko kitne funds chahiye?' Mr. Ahuja ne ek figure batayi. Mr. Malhotra ne Rohan ki taraf dekha. Rohan ne halka sa sir hilaya. 'Well Mr. Ahuja,' Mr. Malhotra ne kaha, 'hum aapko funds provide karenge. Lekin kuch conditions hain.' Sanjana ne khushi se tali bajai. 'Thank god!' Mr. Malhotra ne haath uthaya. 'Lekin decision making power hamare paas rahegi. Aur haan, iss company mein kuch major management changes honge.' Mr. Ahuja pareshaan ho gaye. 'Lekin Sir, kaunsa manager?' Mr. Malhotra ne Rohan ki taraf dekha. 'Aakhir mein, Mr. Ahuja, sab decisions Rohan Luthra hi lenge.' Poora room chaunk gaya. Sanjana ka mooh khula reh gaya. Woh Rohan ko ghoor rahi thi.

Part 5: Room mein sannata chha gaya. Sanjana ne zor se hansna shuru kar diya. 'Yeh driver? Tumhara CEO? Mazaak mat karo!' Mr. Malhotra ne Sanjana ki taraf dekha, unki aankhon mein gussa tha. 'Yeh koi mazaak nahi hai, Ms. Ahuja. Yeh hain Rohan Luthra, Luthra Industries ke CEO.' Sanjana aur Mr. Ahuja dono ka rang udd gaya. Rohan ne aage kadam badhaye. Usne apni driver uniform utaari, aur uske neeche ek mahanga, designer suit tha. Usne us suit ka button band kiya, aur board room ke head chair par jaakar baith gaya. 'Baithiye Mr. Ahuja,' Rohan ne ek thandi awaaz mein kaha. 'Aapki company, aur aapki saari properties, ab meri hain.' Mr. Ahuja ke haath se file gir gayi. Rohan ne apni tablet uthai. 'Pichle 6 mahine se, aap log mujhe driver samajh kar insult karte rahe. Ms. Sanjana, aapne toh mujhe apni party mein waiters ke saath khada kar diya tha. Yaad hai?' Sanjana ka chehra peela pad chuka tha. 'Lekin Mr. Ahuja,' Rohan ne unhe dekha, 'aapka plan toh Sanjana ki shaadi karwa kar apne business ko bachana tha na? Lekin ab toh aapki company hi nahi rahi. Aur jahan tak Sanjana ki baat hai,' Rohan ne Sanjana ko ghoora, 'usse main apni company mein ek position dunga. Jo use uski asli jagah dikhayegi.' Sanjana ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye. 'Rohan... Mr. Luthra... please!' Rohan ne uski taraf dekha, uske chehre par ab ek thandi muskaan thi. 'Aaj se, Mr. Ahuja, aap aur Sanjana, mere iss company mein 'employees' hain... jahan main har subah aapki 'driver' wali seat par baitha hua milunga.'

Part 6: Sanjana ki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the. Mr. Ahuja Rohan ke kadmon mein gir gaye. 'Please, Rohan Sir, aisa mat kijiye. Hum barbaad ho jayenge!' Rohan ne unhe uthaya. 'Barbaad toh aap log tabhi ho gaye the jab aapne insaniyat ka ghera tod diya tha. Aur ab aapke paas koi option nahi hai.' Usne ek file unki taraf badhai. 'Yeh aapka naya contract hai. Sign kijiye. Ya phir sab kuch kho dijiye.' Mr. Ahuja ne kaanpte haathon se sign kiya. Sanjana bhi ro rahi thi, 'Mujhe kya karna hoga?' Rohan ne Priya ki taraf dekha. Priya jo ab tak chupchaap sab dekh rahi thi, Rohan ke paas aayi. 'Mr. Luthra,' usne dheere se kaha, 'aapne yeh sab kyun kiya?' Rohan ne Priya ko dekha. 'Main bas ek sach dekhna chahta tha. Ki log paiso ke bina kitne sachche hote hain.' Priya ne sir hilaya. 'Toh ab?' Rohan muskuraya. 'Ab nayi shuruat hogi.' Usne Priya ko ek file di. 'Aap kal se meri company mein senior marketing head hain.' Priya shock ho gayi. Sanjana ne Rohan aur Priya ko baat karte dekha, uski aankhon mein jealousy aur regret tha. Agli subah. Rohan apne lavish CEO office mein baitha tha, phone par baat kar raha tha. Darwaza knock hua. Rohan ne 'Come in' kaha. Andar Sanjana thi, ek simple, saadi si uniform mein, uske haath mein kapda aur car polish ki bottle thi. Uska chehra utra hua tha. 'Sir,' usne kaanpte hue kaha. 'Mera pehla assignment... aapki gaadi polish karna hai. Main jaanti hoon yeh mera karma hai. Lekin kya... kya aap meri taraf ek baar dekh sakte hain?' Rohan ne dheere se apni chair ghumaai, uske honthon par ek halki si smirk thi.
current.soFar: Sanjana Ahuja, ek ghamandi aur ameer ladki, apne driver Rohan ko har din insult karti hai. Rohan ko woh sirf ek naukar maanti hai, jise woh car keys uchhal kar dete hai aur uski t-shirt par taana maarti hai. Lekin Rohan sirf Sanjana ka driver nahi hai. Woh sheher ka sabse bada CEO hai, Ahuja Industries ka asli maalik. Audience ko is sach ka pata hai, jab Rohan phone par Mr. Mehta se company ke valuation ke baare mein baat karta hai. Rohan chupchaap Sanjana ke behaviour ko jhel raha hai, ek bade plan ko anjaam dene ke liye. Part 1 ke ant mein, Sanjana ka designer bag paani ke puddle mein gir jaata hai, aur woh Rohan ko madad ke liye awaaz deti hai. Rohan use dekhta hai, aur phir uske bag ko, ek gehri saans lete hue.
current.cliffhanger: Rohan ne Sanjana ko dekha, phir neeche paani se bhare designer bag ko... aur ek gehri saans usne andar li... jaise woh koi bada faisla lene wala ho, jaise yeh uske plan ka agla kadam ho, jise woh ab poora karne wala tha.
